packageRules.description: Keep routine project inputs current once CI passes. Only patch/pin/pinDigest/digest — NOT major or minor, which need human review before merge (org policy: tuna-os/.github#12). Copying 'major'/'minor' into this list is exactly the mistake that bypassed the org gate in 11 repos (tunaOS#1612) after they onboarded from an earlier, unsafe version of this template.
Reduce CI churn from rapidly moving base-image digests
